historyContract.modelInput: The HTTP replay retains actual ordered user messages and actual preceding assistant replies from the same authenticated conversation; no gold answers are substituted. Canonical privacy filtering sends user-only dialogue messages to the model, with authorized server context and server-owned semantic continuation restored from encrypted storage. Retaining actual HTTP replies does not mean forwarding raw assistant text to the model. Review metadata is not model input.
historyContract.conversationBinding: Start a distinct conversation per case; require every successful response to retain the server canonical conversation ID and current principal.
historyContract.failedTurn: On transport UNKNOWN, timeout, malformed response or HTTP non-201, stop the entire batch; never insert an invented assistant answer or continue from corpus gold. Record authority refusals separately.
historyContract.retry: The batch never retries a chat request or resumes after STOP. Existing bounded model-stage retries remain possible within the same run and consume the shared 36-attempt cap.
historyContract.entityAuthority: Names/IDs in corpus are preferences only; current authorized catalogs and persisted source owners resolve facts.
